settings.heading: Questions, answered properly
settings.body: If the answer you need isn’t here, email us and a person will reply.

settings.question: How does a pressuriser work?
settings.answer: A ball leaks because the pressure inside it is higher than the air around it. Seal the ball in a chamber held at a higher pressure and the leak stops — and a soft ball slowly comes back up.

settings.question: What pressure does it hold?
settings.answer: 16–18 PSI. Padel balls sit at 10.1–11.4 PSI under FIP rules and tennis balls at roughly 12–14, so the tube stays comfortably above both.

settings.question: Why does the gauge matter?
settings.answer: Because a tube that leaks is worse than no tube at all — it gives you false confidence. The gauge is the difference between trusting a claim and checking one.

settings.question: Can I use it for tennis balls?
How many balls does it hold?
settings.answer: Four. A standard can is three, so there is room for a spare.

settings.question: Will it revive completely dead balls?
settings.answer: Partly, and it depends how far gone they are. A ball that has been loose in a bag for six months has usually lost its felt and its bounce. The tube is for keeping good balls good.

settings.question: How fast do you dispatch?
settings.answer: Within one working day of your order. You get tracking by email the moment it leaves.

settings.question: How much is delivery?
settings.answer: Free over £60 in the UK. Below that it is £3.95, tracked. EU delivery is £7.95 with duties prepaid.

settings.question: Which countries do you ship to?
settings.answer: United Kingdom, Ireland and the EU as standard. Email us for anywhere else and we will quote it.

settings.question: What is your returns policy?
settings.answer: Thirty days from delivery, unused and in its box. Email us and we send a label.

settings.question: How do I claim the pressure guarantee?
settings.answer: Email a photo of the gauge with the date. If it has dropped more than 1 PSI in 30 days we send a replacement — you keep the original.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you take?
settings.answer: All major cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Klarna.
